output.audience: Tourists from Hyderabad, Bangalore and surrounding areas, primarily mobile users accessing via smartphones, using English language
business_goals: Improve online visibility for Velugu Cove
Improve visitor experience with accurate information
Encourage tourists from Hyderabad and Bangalore

content_responsibilities.item: Sea Breeze Homestay photos and room details
Ravi's Fish Kitchen menu and opening hours
Cove Boat Tours tour details and safety info

output.executive_summary: Velugu Cove Tourism Website is a single-page, mobile‑first site that showcases three local businesses – Sea Breeze Homestay, Ravi's Fish Kitchen and Cove Boat Tours – and encourages visitors to contact them via WhatsApp. The site will provide basic information, photos and WhatsApp enquiry buttons for each business. It is built to launch within five days and improve online visibility for the destination.

glossary.definition: A clickable element that opens a WhatsApp chat with a pre‑filled message to the business.
A message automatically inserted into the WhatsApp chat when the button is clicked.
A website that contains all content on one page, typically using anchors or sections.

non_functional: 3‑second page load time on typical 4G connection
Supported browsers: Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge
out_of_scope: Online payments and payment gateway integration
Integrated room reservation and booking management
Administrative dashboards or complex content management systems
Automatic menu, room availability, or tour schedule management
